observedBriefText: 8,760 valid weather hours. Exceedance conditions: 0.4, 1 and 2 percent of valid weather hours exceed the stated value. Coincident values are the state of that same single ranked hour. They are NOT ASHRAE mean coincident values: ASHRAE obtains MCDB and MCWB by double-binning hourly data into joint frequency matrices and taking the conditional mean at the design condition, over a nominal 25-year station record. This ranked-hour statistic uses the supplied valid weather spanning 1 local calendar year (2025), which may be partial records, not an assumed multi-year climate normal (see docs/EVIDENCE-HOT-HUMID.md). Latent equipment belongs to the dew-point family of design conditions, not to dry bulb with coincident wet bulb. Joint failure ranks eligible hours by temperature degree-hours plus VPD kPa-hours outside the band. Peak loads are single-hour maxima and do not include a safety factor.

Pad + vent baseline: matched modeled operating cost $22,060.97 over 8,759 common eligible hours across all compared scenarios. This excludes 1 valid hour, including 1 warm-up hour; any remainder is non-common or otherwise ineligible. Full-run modeled operating cost $22,064.29 covers 8,760 valid hours, including warm-up. Operating-cost differences and cost per added hour use the matched population, not subtraction of full-run totals. Full-run basis: Model-estimated annual operating cost. Period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Included: purchased electricity, purchased heating fuel, water represented by the scenario. Applied prices: electricity 0.12 USD/kWh (manual scenario input); fuel 0.045 USD/kWh (scenario input); water 0.002 USD/L (scenario input). Excluded: installed capital, maintenance, labor, financing, taxes, demand charges, fixed charges, time-of-use effects, other unmodeled tariff components. Not an equipment quote or guaranteed savings.
